task.title: Viewing Clair security scans by using the API
task.shortdesc: To view Clair security scan results for a repository manifest in Red Hat Quay, you can call the manifest security API endpoint with an OAuth access token.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/manifest/{manifestref}/security endpoint to retrieve security information about a specific manifest in a repository. For example:
